data.title: Commerce Commission Plans Unresolved-Issues Statement on T&G Fresh Sale
data.description:
T&G Global Limited ( (NZ:TGG) ) has shared an announcement.

T&G Global is a fresh-produce business that grows and partners with growers to market, sell and distribute nutritious produce in more than 55 countries. It is part of BayWa Global Produce and operates across 13 markets with 1,780 employees.

The New Zealand Commerce Commission plans to publish a Statement of Unresolved Issues regarding J & P Turner Limited’s application to acquire T&G Fresh, which owns T&G’s New Zealand domestic fresh-produce business. The Commission has advised it will seek an extension, with its decision due by 15 March 2027 after the sale agreement’s conditions deadline; the update is not a final clearance or refusal.

data.title: JustCo Reports 60-Centre Network and Positive Cash EBITDA in 9M2026
data.description:
JustCo Holdings Limited ( (SG:JCO) ) has provided an update.

JustCo Holdings Limited operates a flexible workspace business that includes coworking, coliving and retail experiences across Singapore and overseas markets.

For the nine months ended 30 September 2026, the company’s network grew to 60 operational centres from 50 at 31 December 2025, after opening 10 centres in three new markets: India, Malaysia and the Philippines. Group blended occupancy was 79%, comprising 84% for pre-2026 centres and 23% for centres opened in 2026, while cash balance rose to US$167 million from US$104 million and cash EBITDA remained positive.

data.description:

Altiplano Minerals is a company with exploration assets and the El Peñon processing facility; the release does not specify primary products, services or markets. data.title: PPK Provides 2026 AGM Chair’s Address and Presentation
data.description:
PPK Group Limited ( (AU:PPK) ) just unveiled an update.

PPK Group provided its chair’s address and presentation for its 2026 annual general meeting on 24 November 2026. The materials highlighted the company’s sale of its interest in Craig International Ballistics (CIB).

PPK said it received $27.2 million in cash from the sale, compared with its original $5 million investment, a 454 per cent return, and had received $9.4 million in cash distributions during the investment period. PPK said CIB’s board concluded Mehler was the right international partner, and that PPK supported accepting the offer.
